config.ccextras.label: CCExtras Settings
config.ccextras.chat.emojis.description: Adds an emoji menu and autocompletion for emoji codes (e.g. :smile:) to the chat.
config.ccextras.chat.clearHistory.descri: Removes all client-side chat messages stored by CCExtras.
config.ccextras.chat.highlightColor.desc: Color used to highlight your player name in chat.
If enabled, the default chat will be hidden and replaced by the custom chat.
settings.ccextras.title: Settings
settings.ccextras.footer: Changes apply instantly and are saved on close · Right-click: default · Tab: category
settings.ccextras.category.general.sub.d: CCExtras language and design, size of held items, particles and lightning, overall sound volume, and access to the HUD editor.
settings.ccextras.category.information.s: Extra information in item tooltips and HUD displays, with the sounds of the alerts. Positions are set in the HUD editor.
Displays in the Aincraft dimension: scoreboard, event timer, stage cards, materials, coins and alerts for rare and super stack mobs including sounds.
settings.ccextras.category.blacksmith.su: Highlights forged items in the inventory - each forging condition can be toggled and given its own colour and crafting sound.
settings.ccextras.category.animations.su: Every animation on its own: blueprint drops and skill level-ups with opacity and sound, plus death and opening animations.
settings.ccextras.category.developer.sub: Development tools: debug output per system and saving texture sequences.
settings.ccextras.language.desc: Language of all CCExtras texts. Applied instantly.
settings.ccextras.heldItemScale.desc: Scales main- and off-hand items in first person.
settings.ccextras.particleScale.desc: Scales all particles. Smaller particles block less view in combat.
settings.ccextras.lightningScale.desc: Scales how lightning strikes are drawn.
settings.ccextras.deathAnimation.desc: Killed mobs fall over as usual. Off: they disappear immediately.
settings.ccextras.hudEditorKey.desc: Allows opening the HUD editor with its key (F8 by default, changeable in the controls).
settings.ccextras.openHudEditor.desc: Opens the HUD editor to move and scale displays. Only available in a world.
settings.ccextras.fadeHudWithDebugScreen: While the F3 debug screen is open, all CCExtras overlays are drawn mostly transparent so the F3 values stay readable. They return to normal once it is closed.
settings.ccextras.debugScreenHudTranspar: How transparent the overlays are while the F3 debug screen is open. 0 % = unchanged, 100 % = fully hidden.
settings.ccextras.materialInfo.desc: Shows in material tooltips what they are used for and where.
settings.ccextras.aspectInfo.desc: Shows the values of an item's aspects in its tooltip.
settings.ccextras.essenceInfo.desc: Shows the effect of essences in their tooltip.
settings.ccextras.shinyFishInfo.desc: Hints about shiny fish while fishing.
settings.ccextras.equipmentInfo.desc: Shows worn equipment with durability in the HUD.
settings.ccextras.blueprintOverall.desc: Allows the total cost display of all pinned blueprints (toggle with F9).
settings.ccextras.aincraftScoreboard.des: Shows the server scoreboard in the Aincraft dimension. Turn off if the CCExtras displays are enough.
settings.ccextras.eventTimer.desc: Shows the Aincraft and Farmzone events that are running right now and how long they still last.
settings.ccextras.eventTimerAincraft.des: Shows in the event timer which event is running in Aincraft.
settings.ccextras.eventTimerFarmzone.des: Shows in the event timer which event is running in the Farmzone.
settings.ccextras.aincraftStageCard.desc: Card with information about the current stage.
settings.ccextras.aincraftStageStatue.de: Shows the statues of the current stage.
settings.ccextras.aincraftMaterials.desc: List of materials that drop in the current stage.
settings.ccextras.aincraftCoins.desc: Calculates your coin rate while farming.
settings.ccextras.rareMobInfo.desc: Message at the crosshair when a rare mob is nearby.
settings.ccextras.rareMobLocator.desc: Direction indicator to the nearest rare mob.
settings.ccextras.stackedMobInfo.desc: Message at the crosshair when a super stack mob is nearby.
settings.ccextras.stackedMobLocator.desc: Direction indicator to the nearest super stack mob.
settings.ccextras.highlightType.desc: Frame around the slot or a tinted slot background.
settings.ccextras.condition.highlight.de: Marks items with this forging condition in the inventory.
settings.ccextras.condition.color.desc: Colour of the marking. Click the swatch for sliders, hex value and presets.
settings.ccextras.condition.star.desc: Star-forged items get their own animated marking.
settings.ccextras.condition.star.color.d: Base colour of the animated star-forged marking.
settings.ccextras.condition.pulse.desc: Makes the star-forged marking pulse and sparkle. Off: static marking.
settings.ccextras.opacity.desc: How opaque the animation is drawn.
settings.ccextras.debug.desc: Writes debug output of the systems selected below to the log.
settings.ccextras.debug.system.desc: Debug output of this system (only with debug mode on).
settings.ccextras.debug.system.title: Title
settings.ccextras.saveTextures.desc: Saves all resource pack textures to config/ccextras/resourcepack_textures.json (template for the bundled backup).
settings.ccextras.loadTextures.desc: Loads the textures from the bundled backup. Needs two clicks.
settings.ccextras.chat.title: Chat settings
settings.ccextras.chat.footer: Changes apply instantly · Right-click a row: default
settings.ccextras.chat.replaceVanilla.de: Replaces the vanilla chat with the CCExtras chat and its message containers.
settings.ccextras.chat.inputWidth.desc: Width of the chat input including the emoji and settings buttons.
settings.ccextras.chat.lineSpacing.desc: Extra space between the lines of a message.
settings.ccextras.chat.showTime.desc: Shows when each message arrived, left of it.
settings.ccextras.chat.timePattern.desc: Time pattern, e.g. HH:mm or HH:mm:ss. Invalid patterns are not applied.
settings.ccextras.chat.showDate.desc: Also shows the date below the time.
settings.ccextras.chat.datePattern.desc: Date pattern, e.g. dd.MM.yyyy or dd.MM.
settings.ccextras.chat.background.desc: Draws a container behind each message.
settings.ccextras.chat.backgroundAlpha.d: Container opacity while the chat is closed.
settings.ccextras.chat.focusedAlpha.desc: Container opacity while the chat is open.
settings.ccextras.chat.highlightName.des: Colours your player name in messages.
settings.ccextras.chat.mentionSound.desc: Plays a sound when someone writes your name.
settings.ccextras.chat.contextMenu.desc: Right-click or the menu button on a message: copy, delete, ignore.
settings.ccextras.chat.emojis.desc: Emoji button next to the input and suggestions for codes like :smile:.
settings.ccextras.chat.maxHistory.desc: How many messages the chat history keeps.
settings.ccextras.chat.fade.desc: With the chat closed, messages disappear after this time. 0 s: never.
settings.ccextras.chat.clear.desc: Removes all chat messages stored by CCExtras. Needs two clicks.
settings.ccextras.chat.ignoredPlayers.de: Messages from these players are hidden.
settings.ccextras.chat.ignoredMessages.d: Messages with exactly this text are hidden.
settings.ccextras.chat.regexFilters.desc: Messages matching a regular expression are hidden.
settings.ccextras.chat.commandHotkeys.de: Any number of keys that each send a command. Click the key field and press a key (F13–F24 too) or an extra mouse button such as back/forward, optionally with Ctrl, Shift or Alt; Esc cancels. The command works with or without / . Fires in game and in server menus, not while typing in a text field.
settings.ccextras.search.desc: Searches names, descriptions, groups and categories of all settings. The number on a category shows its results; clicking it opens the category. Esc clears the search.
settings.ccextras.search.chatHint: Chat settings: gear in the chat input
settings.ccextras.chat.moveHint: Drag to move · Right-click: back next to the chat
settings.ccextras.category.fabrik.sub.de: The boss zone in your factory (gradient, animation, opacity), the boss panel and boss wave sound, and the wave directions.
settings.ccextras.bossZone.desc: Draws the boss zone boundary as an animated gradient border.
settings.ccextras.bossZoneOnlyInside.des: Shows the border only while you stand in the zone. Off: already when you are near it.
settings.ccextras.bossZoneViewDistance.d: Distance to the zone at which the border appears (only when it is not limited to the inside).
settings.ccextras.bossZoneColorStart.des: First color of the gradient that travels around the zone.
settings.ccextras.bossZoneColorEnd.desc: Second color of the gradient that travels around the zone.
settings.ccextras.bossZoneOpacity.desc: Opacity of the walls, edges and floor ring.
settings.ccextras.bossZoneSpeed.desc: Speed of the gradient, scan band, stripes and pulse. 0 freezes the animation.
settings.ccextras.bossZoneStripes.desc: Diagonal moving stripes on the walls.
settings.ccextras.bossZoneParticles.desc: Rising particles in the gradient color and occasional lightning arcs.
settings.ccextras.capacityAlerts.desc: Shows a panel when a capacity is full or a recycler slot is empty. The values are read from the widget system (tab list) – wherever you placed them there.
settings.ccextras.capacityAlert.anvil.de: Reports full anvils (several separately). The 'Anvil capacity' widget must be shown in the widget system, otherwise the value cannot be read.
Reports full furnaces (several separately). The 'Furnace capacity' widget must be shown in the widget system, otherwise the value cannot be read.
settings.ccextras.capacityAlert.hunter.d: Reports a full hunter capacity. The 'Hunter capacity' widget must be shown in the widget system, otherwise the value cannot be read.
settings.ccextras.capacityAlert.souls.de: Reports a full soul capacity. The 'Soul capacity' widget must be shown in the widget system, otherwise the value cannot be read.
settings.ccextras.capacityAlert.essences: Reports a full essence capacity. The 'Essence capacity' widget must be shown in the widget system, otherwise the value cannot be read.
settings.ccextras.capacityAlert.recycler: Reports empty recycler slots (0 materials) that need refilling. 'Recycler slot 1–3' must be shown in the widget system, otherwise the values cannot be read.
settings.ccextras.bagAutoScan.desc: When opened from 'Bags', pages through raw materials, processed materials, mob materials, fishing bag and essence bag (including filters) and returns to the start. Your own click stops it. The stock is used for blueprints.
settings.ccextras.blueprintPinHotkeys.de: Shows the hotkeys small below the pinned blueprint (switch, amount, remove, overall costs).
settings.ccextras.blueprintSearch.desc: Shows the blueprints you are searching for, how many you still need to find and where they drop (Aincraft floor). Add one in the NECI with Shift+right-click on a blueprint (each click +1), Ctrl+right-click removes one. Like the pinned blueprint, keys (default: numpad 4/6) select an entry, which is highlighted, and change only its amount (8/2 ±1, 9/3 ±10, 0 remove). Every chat message "You receive … - [Blueprint]" counts down. At 0 the entry is marked green as found and stays until you remove it. Hidden while empty.
settings.ccextras.blueprintSearchHotkeys: Shows the hotkeys small below the blueprint search (switch, amount, remove). They only apply to the highlighted entry.
settings.ccextras.blueprintSearch.editor: Set position and size of the blueprint search in the HUD editor.
settings.ccextras.group.overallHide: Hide while overall costs are shown
settings.ccextras.overallHide.desc: Hidden while the overall blueprint costs are shown.
settings.ccextras.animationSound.desc: The sound the server sends with the animation. If the animation is triggered again while it is still running, it does not play again.
settings.ccextras.animationVolume.desc: Volume of the sound relative to the original.
settings.ccextras.animationTest.desc: Starts the animation with its sound like the server does, to test volume and timing.
settings.ccextras.bossZoneRenderMode.des: How the walls are drawn. Automatic: classic without shaders, shader compatible with a shader pack. If the zone looks wrong with your shader, try the other options.
settings.ccextras.mobNametags.desc: Shows the name tags of all mobs (including holograms riding a mob). Players and free-standing holograms always stay visible.
settings.ccextras.centerMobModels.desc: Shifts a mob's model horizontally into its hitbox while drawing, also during animations, so you hit the mob where you see it. Purely visual: hitbox, position and everything sent to the server stay unchanged.
settings.ccextras.aincraftMobPanel.desc: Shows the mob of the current floor as a 3D model with its health, the floor and defeated/required mobs. Position in the HUD editor.
settings.ccextras.aincraftMobPanelRotate: Slowly rotates the 3D model. Off: fixed angled view.
settings.ccextras.debugScreenInspector.d: Panel in every inventory: raw screen name (resource pack glyphs as \uXXXX), plain text, JSON, class, menu type, hovered item and all resource pack matches - scrollable. Left click copies raw, right click escaped; hovering a match shows its graphic.
settings.ccextras.debugMobLexiconInspect: Panel in the mob lexicon: mob, Aincraft stage, coins, card and statue with chance, the stage's blueprints with rarity, and the rune blueprint at 1500 kills. "Start scan" clicks every mob item with short pauses and turns pages until the last one; can be cancelled. Copy per stage, everything, runes only (also as runes.json) or blueprints only (also as JSON).
settings.ccextras.debugCollectionInspect: Panel in every inventory: enter the name of the open collection and press "Read". Reads slots 10–16 (name tags with CustomModelData 3 or 4), turns the page once via slot 23 and reads the second page. Captures name, progress, x/y and rewards per level. Several collections are collected and can be copied together as text or JSON.
settings.ccextras.debugRawFont.desc: Draws raw text with the vanilla unifont so the server resource pack font cannot change it.
Every tooltip (chat, inventories, interface) shows the key "Debug: Inspect tooltip". Pressing it pins the tooltip in its own panel: raw with formatting codes, plain text, JSON, item info and all resource pack matches with their graphic on hover. Left click copies raw, right click escaped.
settings.ccextras.debugEntityInspector.d: Shows type, raw name, health and tags of the targeted entity in the HUD - holograms included. The "Debug: Copy target info" key copies all info; full details are in the debug inspector.
settings.ccextras.debugBossZoneAlways.de: Draws the boss zone everywhere (also outside the factory and the zone) to test its look.
settings.ccextras.checkForUpdates.desc: Checks on startup whether a newer CCExtras version was released on GitHub. If so, a notice appears on the title screen and pause menu: download it right away (installed when you quit) or dismiss it.
settings.ccextras.checkUpdatesNow.desc: Checks for a newer version right away and shows a dismissed notice again.
settings.ccextras.stackIndicator.desc: Shows a badge with the count (from [x] in the name) above stacked and super stacked mobs - even with name tags hidden. Only in line of sight and up to 32 blocks.
settings.ccextras.mobHealthbar.desc: Shows a custom health bar above mobs - even with name tags hidden. Stacked mobs get one combined display with stack count and health. Only in line of sight and up to 32 blocks. In the factory the bar only shows on the mob under your crosshair.
settings.ccextras.mobHealthbarFocusedOnl: On: the health bar only shows on the mob under your crosshair (up to 32 blocks). Off: on all mobs in line of sight. The stack count stays visible on all stacked mobs.
settings.ccextras.mobHealthbarNumbers.de: Shows the current and full health next to the bar (e.g. 24 / 38).
settings.ccextras.mobHealthbarOnlyDamage: Only shows the health bar once a mob has taken damage. The stack count stays visible.
settings.ccextras.debugInspector.desc: Window with all debug info instead of chat output: last screen name, free resource pack search (glyphs, \uXXXX, name, path) with graphic preview, targeted entity and named entities/holograms nearby, Aincraft detection. Everything copies on click. Also via the "Debug: Open inspector" key.
settings.ccextras.customThemeColor.desc: Colors the whole CCExtras interface (windows, HUD, chat, tooltips) in your color instead of emerald green. Status colors like health, warnings and rarities stay the same.
settings.ccextras.themeColor.desc: The accent color (RGB). Surfaces, lines and text are derived from it.
settings.ccextras.themeOpacity.desc: Alpha of the design color: how opaque the dark panel surfaces are. Lower values let more of the game shine through.
settings.ccextras.weather.desc: Shows the current weather (clear, rain, snow, thunder, windy) and how long it has lasted. Position in the HUD editor.
settings.ccextras.bossBarOverlay.combo_c: Shows the Aincraft combo chest with tier, combo count and "Combo up!!" animation in its own place instead of as a boss bar. Off: not shown at all. Position in the HUD editor.
settings.ccextras.bossBarOverlay.skill_c: Shows whether the skill on this key is ready or still on cooldown, in its own place instead of as a boss bar. Off: not shown at all. Position in the HUD editor.
settings.ccextras.bossBarOverlay.skill_x: Shows the skill's experience bar in its own place instead of as a boss bar. Off: not shown at all. Position in the HUD editor.
Move and scale the combo chest, skill cooldowns and experience bars in the HUD editor.
settings.ccextras.bossZoneOnlyBossWave.d: Shows the boss zone only during a boss wave (wave 100, 200, 300, ...). The wave is read from the boss bar in the factory.
settings.ccextras.bossWavePanel.desc: During a boss wave shows the boss (3D model, health) and your chance to win - based on your damage per second, the damage you take minus your health regeneration, your health (action bar, weapon in hand) and the time left in the wave (scoreboard). Position in the HUD editor.
settings.ccextras.hideLeaderboards.desc: Hides the leaderboards in Aincraft (e.g. "Top Kills"). The floor's required kills counter stays visible.
settings.ccextras.share.export.desc: Copies all settings as a code to the clipboard - e.g. to send them to friends. Developer settings and the GitHub token are not included.
settings.ccextras.share.import.desc: Applies the settings from a copied code (clipboard). Click twice to confirm; your current settings are overwritten.
settings.ccextras.share.title: CCExtras settings
settings.ccextras.share.invalid: No valid settings code in the clipboard
settings.ccextras.updateChannel.desc: Release: updates from the public repository (like all players). Beta: additionally alpha/beta versions from the private repository - needs a GitHub token.
settings.ccextras.updateToken.desc: Fine-grained token with read access (Contents: Read-only) to Energyps/CCExtras. Stored separately from the config in config/ccextras/secrets.json (readable only by your user) and never exported. Paste with Ctrl+V.
settings.ccextras.forgingHotbar.desc: Also marks forging conditions in the hotbar, not only in inventories.
settings.ccextras.hideMoblexiconAnimatio: The full-screen animation when opening the Moblexicon. Off: it is suppressed.
settings.ccextras.hideAirshipAnimation.d: The full-screen animation when opening the airship. Off: it is suppressed.
settings.ccextras.capacityAlert.research: Reports each of your up to three researches separately once its timer in the boss bar has run out – until you have been back in the factory.
settings.ccextras.capacityAlert.power_cr: Level and progress of the three power crystal slots; alerts from the threshold on. The power crystal widgets must be shown in the tab list.
settings.ccextras.capacityAlert.combo_ch: Combo chest progress on Aincraft floors (boss bar digits plus the value after 🌟 in the scoreboard) against the goal.
settings.ccextras.capacityComboGoal.desc: The value at which the combo chest counts as ready.
settings.ccextras.capacityShowAll.desc: Always shows all enabled values, not only alerts. Values past the threshold are coloured.
settings.ccextras.capacityShowPercent.de: Shows the fill level in percent instead of "full" or "refill".
settings.ccextras.capacitySeparate.desc: Each kind gets its own overlay that can be moved separately in the HUD editor.
settings.ccextras.capacityIcons.desc: Small icon in front of each entry.
settings.ccextras.capacityThreshold.desc: The fill level at which an alert appears (100 % = only when full; power crystals also above 100 %).
settings.ccextras.capacityThresholdLow.d: Up to which fill level a recycler slot is reported as "refill" or research as "done" (0 % = only when empty).
settings.ccextras.capacityColor.desc: Colour of the icon and value of this kind.
settings.ccextras.animationSeparatePosit: Each animation (epic and legendary drop, mining, foraging, fishing and alchemy level) gets its own overlay in the HUD editor. Off: all animations appear in the same place.
settings.ccextras.animationPositions.edi: Opens the HUD editor to move and scale the animations. Only available in a world.
settings.ccextras.condition.sound.desc: Plays a confirmation sound when you craft an item with this forging condition.
settings.ccextras.soundCueVolume.desc: Volume of all confirmation sounds. They also follow Minecraft's "Interface" volume slider.
settings.ccextras.soundVolumeLightning.d: Volume of lightning strikes and thunder. Applies on top of Minecraft's sliders, 0 % mutes the sound.
settings.ccextras.soundVolumeExplosion.d: Volume of explosions. Applies on top of Minecraft's sliders, 0 % mutes the sound.
settings.ccextras.soundVolumeFirework.de: Volume of firework rockets (launch, blast, twinkle). Applies on top of Minecraft's sliders, 0 % mutes the sound.
settings.ccextras.soundVolumeLevelUp.des: Volume of Minecraft's level-up sound. Applies on top of Minecraft's sliders, 0 % mutes the sound.
settings.ccextras.sound.preset.desc: Which sound is played. You hear it right away when switching.
settings.ccextras.sound.custom.desc: Sound ID for "Custom sound", e.g. minecraft:block.note_block.harp. Sounds from resource packs work too.
settings.ccextras.sound.pitch.desc: 100 % = normal pitch, lower is deeper, higher is brighter.
settings.ccextras.sound.test.desc: Plays the sound with the current settings - even if it is switched off.
settings.ccextras.sound.forging_frost.de: When you craft a frostforged item.
settings.ccextras.sound.forging_lava.des: When you craft a lavaforged item.
settings.ccextras.sound.forging_titan.de: When you craft a titanforged item.
settings.ccextras.sound.forging_dragon.d: When you craft a dragonforged item.
settings.ccextras.sound.forging_demon.de: When you craft a demonforged item.
settings.ccextras.sound.forging_lightnin: When you craft a lightningforged item.
settings.ccextras.sound.forging_star.des: When you craft a starforged item.
settings.ccextras.sound.blueprint_pin_do: When a pinned blueprint has been crafted as often as pinned and the pin disappears.
settings.ccextras.sound.blueprint_search: When a searched blueprint has been found as often as searched (amount 0).
settings.ccextras.sound.rare_mob.desc: When the locator finds a rare mob nearby.
settings.ccextras.sound.stacked_mob.desc: When the locator finds a super stack mob nearby.
settings.ccextras.sound.boss_wave.desc: When a boss wave starts in the factory.
settings.ccextras.sound.chat_mention.des: When someone writes your name in chat.
settings.ccextras.bossWavePanelRotate.de: The boss model in the boss panel slowly rotates. Off: it stays still.
settings.ccextras.mobLocatorBackground.d: Dark background with ring behind the locator arrow. Off: only the arrow is shown.
settings.ccextras.equipmentLayout.desc: Combined: percent and flat values stacked in one overlay. Separate: two overlays that can be moved individually in the HUD editor.
settings.ccextras.blueprintOverallHotkey: Shows below the overall costs which keys toggle and scroll them.
Shows below coins per minute which keys start, stop and reset the stopwatch.
settings.ccextras.shinyFishWorlds.desc: All worlds: the hints appear everywhere. Farm world only: only while you are in the farm world (otherwise the server message stays in chat).
settings.ccextras.shinyFishSpawn.desc: Shows a hint when a school of shiny fish appears in a pond. The server message is then filtered from chat.
settings.ccextras.shinyFishDespawn.desc: Shows a hint when a school of shiny fish disappears from a pond. The server message is then filtered from chat.
settings.ccextras.shinyCatchRainbow.desc: Colours "Shiny" in the chat message about a caught shiny fish with the rainbow effect.
settings.ccextras.waveDirectionInfo.desc: In the factory, 10, 5 and 1 wave before enemies start coming from an additional direction (north from wave 1, east from 30, south from 101, west from 301). Directions whose wave you have already cleared according to the wave menu are no longer reported. When jumping to the next 100 wave you are warned if a new direction gets added.
settings.ccextras.waveHolograms.desc: Shows a hologram at each of the four spawn points in the factory with the direction and the wave from which enemies come from there. Green: wave already reached, red: not yet. The east one also shows that bosses spawn there.
settings.ccextras.waveHologramRange.desc: The spawn point holograms are visible up to this distance. Only the horizontal distance counts, height does not matter.
settings.ccextras.waveDirectionReset.des: Forgets the stored highest cleared wave; it is read again the next time you open the wave menu.
settings.ccextras.animationShow.epic.des: Plays an animation when an epic blueprint drops.
settings.ccextras.animationShow.legendar: Plays an animation when a legendary blueprint drops.
settings.ccextras.animationShow.mining.d: Plays an animation on a mining level-up in the farm world.
settings.ccextras.animationShow.foraging: Plays an animation on a foraging level-up in the farm world.
Plays an animation on a fishing level-up in the farm world.
settings.ccextras.sound.capacity_anvil.d: Plays a sound when the “Anvil” alert newly appears.
settings.ccextras.sound.capacity_furnace: Plays a sound when the “Furnace” alert newly appears.
Plays a sound when the “Hunter” alert newly appears.
settings.ccextras.sound.capacity_souls.d: Plays a sound when the “Souls” alert newly appears.
settings.ccextras.sound.capacity_essence: Plays a sound when the “Essences” alert newly appears.
settings.ccextras.sound.capacity_recycle: Plays a sound when the “Recycler slot” alert newly appears.
settings.ccextras.sound.capacity_researc: Plays a sound when the “Research” alert newly appears.
settings.ccextras.sound.capacity_power_c: Plays a sound when the “Power crystal” alert newly appears.
settings.ccextras.sound.capacity_combo_c: Plays a sound when the “Combo chest” alert newly appears.
settings.ccextras.highestWave.desc: The highest wave you have beaten in the factory, read from the waves menu or the boss bar. Open the waves menu once if it is still missing.
Plays an animation on an alchemy level-up in the farm world.
settings.ccextras.capacityMini.desc: Only icon and state in a small box, without a header. Applies to this alert's own overlay, so only with “Separate overlays”.
settings.ccextras.blueprintClassFilter.d: Dims or hides (see Display) every blueprint in the blacksmith's blueprint inventories (weapons, armor, tools, favorites, blueprint shop) whose description says it is not suitable for your class. The items stay untouched: tooltip and clicks keep working. Can also be toggled right in the inventory with the shield button.
settings.ccextras.blueprintClassFilterMo: How blueprints of other classes look: dimmed with the configured background, or hidden completely so only an empty slot is shown. Can also be switched right in the inventory with the eye button.
settings.ccextras.blueprintClassFilterOp: How strongly blueprints of other classes are dimmed. At 100 % they are fully covered.
settings.ccextras.blueprintClassFilterBu: Shows the shield button next to the search field to switch the class filter on and off right in the blueprint inventory.
settings.ccextras.blueprintSearchField.d: A search field at the blacksmith's blueprint inventories. Matching blueprints get a colored frame, the number of matches is shown next to it. Several words must all match. Right-click the field to clear it, Esc or Enter ends typing.
settings.ccextras.blueprintSearchColor.d: Color of the frame and background of matching blueprints.
settings.ccextras.blueprintSearchPulse.d: Makes the frame of matches glow softly so they stand out at once.
settings.ccextras.blueprintSearchDimOthe: While searching, dims every blueprint that does not match.
settings.ccextras.blueprintSearchDimOpac: How strongly non-matching blueprints are dimmed while searching.
Searches the blueprint description as well (e.g. materials or stats), not only the name.
settings.ccextras.blueprintSearchKeepQue: Keeps the search text after closing the inventory. When off it is only kept while paging and switching between blueprint pages.
settings.ccextras.blueprintBarPosition.d: Whether the search field and class toggle sit below or above the inventory.
settings.ccextras.blueprintBarOffset.des: Moves the search bar if it collides with your resource pack or another overlay.
settings.ccextras.seasonReset.desc: For the start of a new season: deletes everything the mod collected while playing, i.e. pinned blueprints, the blueprint search, materials and essences read from bags, the highest wave reached, observed research, and the coins-per-minute stopwatch. Your settings, overlay positions, keys and NECI favourites are kept. Click twice to confirm.
settings.ccextras.seasonReset.title: New season
settings.ccextras.capacityMiniCombined.d: Shows the combined alert list as a small box with only icons and states, without a header and names.
settings.ccextras.capacityMiniLayout.des: Whether the alerts in the list's mini view are stacked or side by side.
settings.ccextras.farmzoneCollection.des: Shows in a farm zone how long it takes at your current pace to reach the next collection level, plus the blocks still needed and blocks per minute. Like the coin tracker, it only measures after you start it (same keys; in the farm world they control this stopwatch). Counting restarts in another biome. Position in the HUD editor.
settings.ccextras.skillLevelTimer.desc: Shows in the farm world how long it takes to reach the next fishing, mining and woodcutting level and how much XP you gain per minute. Values come from the tab list, so the skills must be shown there. Measures after you start the same stopwatch as the collection. Position in the HUD editor.
settings.ccextras.farmworldTimerHotkeys: Show keys below collection and skills
Shows the start/stop and reset keys (the same as for the coin tracker) below both displays.
settings.ccextras.dataAutoUpdate.desc: On startup, downloads new blueprints, essences, runes, prices and texts from the public CCExtras repository without needing a new mod version. New data takes effect after the next start.
settings.ccextras.dataReset.desc: Deletes the downloaded data. From the next start on, the data of the installed mod version is used again.
settings.ccextras.onlyChanged.desc: Shows only settings that differ from their default, across all categories. Use the arrow next to a setting to reset it on its own. Search can be combined with this filter.
settings.ccextras.hudLayout.export.desc: Copies only the positions, sizes and scales of your HUD elements as a code (also Ctrl+C in the HUD editor).
settings.ccextras.hudLayout.import.desc: Applies a HUD layout from a copied code. Click twice to confirm. In the HUD editor use Ctrl+V, which can be undone with Ctrl+Z.
settings.ccextras.detection.world.desc: Which world CCExtras currently detects. Many displays only appear in their world (e.g. factory waves only in the factory).
settings.ccextras.detection.dimension.de: The ID of the current dimension as reported by the server. Useful for bug reports.
settings.ccextras.detection.serverName.d: The server from the tab list footer ("Aktueller Server"). CCExtras uses it to detect the farm zone, city and Aincraft.
settings.ccextras.detection.tabList.desc: When the tab list last had content. Capacities, collection and skill timers read from it.
settings.ccextras.detection.serverPack.d: Whether the server resource pack is loaded. Without it, icons and some detections are missing.
settings.ccextras.detection.data.desc: Result of the last check of the data files (blueprints, essences, prices …) against the repository.
settings.ccextras.aincraftMaterialRate.d: Shows next to each material in the list how much you collect per minute (rolling five minutes, restarts on each floor).
settings.ccextras.moblexiconExtraInfo.de: Adds the mob HP, the sacrifice MK level that kills them in one hit, and the effects of the floor card and statue to the mob lexicon.
settings.ccextras.aincraftMobPanelKillRa: Kills per minute and time left
Shows in the mob panel how many kills you get per minute and how long the next floor takes at this pace (rolling five minutes).
settings.ccextras.detection.server.desc: CCExtras is only active on PlayLegend and in singleplayer. On other servers the mod stays silent.
settings.ccextras.blueprintCraftableHigh: Blueprints you have all materials for get a green background at the smith.
settings.ccextras.blueprintUncraftableHi: Blueprints with missing materials get a red mark at the smith.
settings.ccextras.blueprintStageInToolti: Adds the Aincraft floor the blueprint drops on as [E 12] to its name in every inventory, with the drop chance from the mob lexicon when known: [E 12 · 0.45%].
settings.ccextras.blueprintInfoInChat.de: Also shows floor and aspect when hovering a blueprint in chat.
settings.ccextras.fabrikLevel.desc: Shows your factory level in the factory, how fast it rises and how long until the next level and the next unlock.
settings.ccextras.blueprintUncraftableCo: Color used to mark uncraftable blueprints.
settings.ccextras.blueprintCraftableButt: Shows a button next to the search field at the smith that cycles between marking craftable, uncraftable, both or none.
settings.ccextras.screenshotMode.key.des: Turns screenshot mode on and off: other players' names in the tab list, name tags and chat are replaced with “Player 1”, “Player 2” … Bind it in Options → Controls → CCExtras – General.
settings.ccextras.screenshotModeOnF2.des: On F2, other players' names are replaced just for the screenshot. The screenshot is taken about 0.1 seconds later.
Screenshot mode replaces your own name as well.
settings.ccextras.neciInventorySearch.de: Whatever you search for in the NECI is marked in every open inventory (inventory, bags, chests, menus). The search stays until you clear it in the NECI or with the chip at the inventory.
settings.ccextras.neciInventorySearchDim: Dims items that don't match the search. Strength and colour as in the blacksmith's blueprint search.
settings.ccextras.neciInventorySearchLor: Also searches the items' descriptions, not just their names.
settings.ccextras.farmzoneRoute.desc: Choose a biome in the route guide (key J): arrows on the ground and a display with a compass arrow lead you there along the recorded paths.
